preset.reason: Evidence is local catalog history, not an audio preset.

project_persistence.reason: Stored in the private application catalog, never a DAW project.

default_reset.reason: Empty on migration/first run. Session reset retains durable evidence. Automatic receipt work is cancelled and its transient coverage summary cleared on reset; committed history remains. Derived date projections and loading/error generations are transient and cleared on reset. Addition bounds and scan coverage remain in local catalog history; coverage stores root physical identity, exclusions, policy and scan interval. Live use polling and projection tasks cancel on reset, scope change and removal; reset clears transient usage state but retains committed history.

migration.reason: SQLite v1/v2/v3 to v4 uses a writer reservation, verified pre-migration backup and atomic migration; unsupported versions remain untouched. Schema4 adds exact-root scan coverage and node addition bounds; legacy first_seen projects only as a present-by upper bound. Receipt provenance remains additive and legacy records decode with nil provenance. Optional hostUsage provenance is additive; legacy records decode nil. Source-local clock components never populate absolute eventDate.

undo.reason: Immutable source evidence, no user-edit or correction feature in this increment.

automation.reason: Internal cancellable receipt and Live use collectors only. Sources checked every 60 seconds while app open; no background service or external command.

copy_paste.reason: No evidence clipboard interface.

sync.reason: Local only; no account or synchronization.

accessibility.reason: Date added and Last used cells/inspector expose precision, product-class scope, format coverage, saved/checking/unavailable/partial states and sort semantics.

privacy.reason: Private local SQLite database; no raw DAW logs or telemetry transmitted. Receipt package IDs, versions and local bundle paths remain private in this ledger and its backups. Local Live logs/cache are read only; retained host version, VST3 CID, local date and stable event hashes exclude raw project paths/logs. No uploads.

export_import.reason: Existing consistent local SQLite backup includes the ledger and optional receipt provenance; no import/merge feature. Optional host provenance and addition bounds are included in the same backup.
